context.body: The bounded canonical source is Judges 2:6–23; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: After Joshua’s generation dies, Israel serves other gods, faces plunderers, cries under oppression, receives judges, and turns back after each judge dies.
observations.label: A generation forgets and a cycle begins: action

observations.body: the nations remain as a test.
observations.label: A generation forgets and a cycle begins: response

payload.posture: Read Judges 2:6–23 as tribes in the land evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Compassionate rescue repeatedly fails to create durable loyalty, and testing does not eliminate Israel’s agency.
payload.title: A generation forgets and a cycle begins
